items.question: Did Michelle Campbell play in the WNBA?
items.answer: Yes. This Michelle Campbell, a Rutgers forward, played 31 regular-season games for the Chicago Sky in 2013, averaging 1.7 points and 1.5 rebounds. A different Michelle Campbell, a USC center, played for the Utah Starzz in 1999 and the Washington Mystics in 2000.
